heading: Announcement banner
description: Message displayed at the very top of the public site, above the contact bar and the main navigation.
readOnlyHint: You can view this banner but not edit it (organization_settings.write permission required).
denied: You do not have access to this banner (organization_settings.read permission required).

fields.enabledOn: Banner displayed on the public site
fields.localeHint: French is required when the banner is enabled. Languages left empty fall back to the French text.
fields.textPlaceholder: E.g. Free cancellation on all bookings until December 31
fields.ctaHint: Shared by all languages. The link is only shown in languages that have a label.
fields.ctaNewTab: Open the link in a new tab

low.label: Light
low.hint: Pale background, dark text — discreet information.

high.label: Strong
high.hint: Solid background — urgent or important message.

preview.title: Preview
preview.fallback: No text in this language: the French text is shown
preview.disabled: Banner disabled — not visible on the site

validation.frenchTextRequired: French text is required to enable the banner.
validation.textRequiredForCta: Add a text for this language or remove the link label.
validation.ctaLabelTooLong: Link label must not exceed {max} characters.
validation.ctaUrlInvalid: Enter an http(s) URL or an internal path starting with /.
validation.ctaUrlRequired: Enter the link URL or remove the link labels.
